sources.title: Patreon Pricing & Fees 2026 - Lite vs Pro vs Premium

limits.en: Free to create a creator page; Patreon only takes a cut of actual patron payments, there is no monthly subscription fee for creators.

keyLimits.en: Creating a Patreon page costs nothing; Patreon only takes a cut once patrons actually pay.
Flat 10% platform fee on membership income for all creators who joined after August 4, 2025, plus payment processing, currency conversion and payout fees.
5% platform fee, available only to creators grandfathered from before August 2025; basic page, posts and patron engagement tools.
8% platform fee (legacy, grandfathered); adds membership tiers, analytics, special offers and app integrations.
12% platform fee (legacy, grandfathered), aimed at established creators with larger operations.

cautions.en: On top of the platform fee, payment processing costs 2.9% + $0.30 per charge (or 5% + $0.10 for pledges under $3), which materially reduces creator take-home.
New creators since August 2025 are locked into the single 10% Standard plan; the cheaper 5%/8% legacy tiers are closed to new signups.

Exact current fee figures could not be verified directly on patreon.com or support.patreon.com in this session (both blocked automated access); figures come from third-party trackers citing Patreon's help center and should be reverified before publishing.

capabilities.en: Recurring membership/subscription pages letting creators charge patrons monthly (or per-post) in exchange for exclusive content and perks.
Membership tiers, analytics, special offers and third-party app integrations available on higher (legacy Pro/Premium or feature-gated) plans.

limitations.en: Platform fee (10% for all new creators) plus separate payment-processing fees stack on top of each other, which is less transparent than a flat all-in percentage.
No self-serve way for new creators to access the lower legacy fee tiers; they are closed to new accounts.
